title: Concentric progress rings fill on a stat card
summary: A white stat card grows from a point, three nested progress rings sweep on from twelve o'clock beside three ratio figures, hold for over a second, then the arcs retract and the card fades back to an empty canvas, so it loops.
use_when: Showing two to four goal-vs-actual figures at once in an analytics or reporting product
A short loopable dashboard widget moment for a feed, landing page or slide
An insert inside a longer film where one card has to prove a result
Light SaaS brands with three distinct accent colours

look.type_style: geometric grotesk; card title bold sentence case ~2.4 % H; figures semibold ~5 % H with a light grey '/total' suffix at ~60 % size; tiny grey legend labels ~1.9 % H next to rounded colour squares

sfx.event: card grows in from the centre
each ring reaches its value and settles
arcs retract and the card leaves

structure.shot: one shot, no cuts: empty light canvas, a rounded white stat card grows in; title, date range, 3 ratio figures with legend on the left, 3 nested rings on the right fill, hold, retract, card fades out
structure.camera: locked off, no camera move (motion.json 1-4 s: pan 0, zoom 0 %/s; the 0-1 s 'camera-mixed' reading is the card growing, not the camera)
structure.motion: card grows 0.35 -> 1.00 scale from the centre on springs.layout, settled by 0.77 s (~23 fr, overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); title + legend fade in 0.27-0.50 s; grey tracks and coloured arcs draw on clockwise from 12 o'clock while the ring group rotates ~90° into place, inner ring first then middle then outer, stagger ~3 fr (±0.25 s), easings.outExpo, all settled by 1.00 s (f30); figures mask-rise 0.50-0.77 s (±0.25 s); hold 1.00-2.27 s (~38 fr); exit 2.27-2.77 s: arc tails retract clockwise toward their ends with easings.inExpo while opacity drops to ~0.15, card fades out by 3.27 s; empty canvas 3.27-4.00 s

params.brand: any brand.json: bg, surface (card), fg, muted, radius, plus three accent colours for the rings
params.content.title: card title, 2-3 words naming the metric group
params.content.subtitle: small grey period line under the title, e.g. a date range
params.content.series: 2-4 items {value, total, label, color}; ring sweep = value / total
params.timing.hold: frames the filled card holds (default 38 at 30 fps)
params.timing.ringStagger: frames between ring starts, inner to outer (default 3)
params.loop: true keeps the empty canvas at both ends so the clip loops seamlessly
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); all timing scales with it

notes: Measured from one 4 fps sheet (±0.25 s) and keyframes at 0.5/1.5/2.5 s. Final sweeps at 1.50 s: inner ~0.82 of a turn (matches 335/400), middle ~0.65 (80/120 = 0.67), outer ~0.37 (45/120 = 0.375): sweep is value/total, so keep it data-true. Ring geometry at 864 px H: radii ~195 / 145 / 95 px, stroke ~28 px, gap ~22 px, light grey full-circle track under each arc, flat (butt) caps. Exit reverses the draw from the start edge, not the end. Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): ring-fill, arc-retract.
